title: Saudian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful dish from the Arabian Peninsula, grilled to perfection with a blend of exotic spices.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Look for lamb with a good marbling of fat for enhanced flavor.

ingredients.name: Exotic spice blend (e.g., sumac, cumin, coriander, cinnamon)
ingredients.notes: Adjust to taste or use store-bought blend.

ingredients.name: Dense, sweet dates, pitted
ingredients.notes: Optional, but traditional in many Arabian dishes.

ingredients.name: Saudian pomegranate molasses
ingredients.notes: For a sweet and tangy glaze.

instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together spice blend, salt, and black pepper. Add the lamb cubes and mix until evenly coated.
3. Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
4. Brush the lamb kebabs with olive oil and place on the grill.
5. Cook for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C) for medium-rare.
6. While the kebabs are grilling, toast the flatbread or pita on the grill or in a toaster.
7. Once the kebabs are cooked, brush with pomegranate molasses and let rest for 5 minutes.
8. Serve the kebabs with toasted flatbread, chopped parsley or cilantro (if using), and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.
9. Traditionally, kebabs are served with dates, but feel free to omit or substitute with other fruits or vegetables.
